baseline_policy: Apply unchanged Run20 score to the same fresh candidates; freeze its winner alongside the augmented-score winner.
fixed_control_reason: Closest fresh candidate to previous allowed-range midpoint 33deg; 27/39 tie resolves to smaller angle.
required_composition: front face >=40%, right face >=5% of visible modeled area; original front logo readable; new viewpoint, no exact-angle customer requirement
fixed: Run19 source photos, source annotations, frozen cuboid and byte-identical renderer/common code; 1600x1067 and same camera calibration. NO geometry refit for rendering.
added_signal: For scoring only, independently triangulate each physical corner from source annotations, then robustly refine each 3D point against source pixels (soft_l1, f_scale=2). Project this source-derived reference and frozen cuboid into each candidate. Do not render from the reference geometry.

selection_rule.structure_px: 0.5*(median visible-corner displacement + median displacement along shared visible-face seams), reference vs frozen cuboid, in candidate pixels
selection_rule.scale_reason: One predeclared heuristic: 5px structural discrepancy contributes 1 score unit. Not calibrated on target photos; no weight search or alternate formulas after results.

evaluation: Reuse final evaluator and same seven physical corner IDs [0,1,2,3,5,6,7]. Report front logo separately; fewer than 6 matches is unscored. Compare augmented winner vs old-score winner and fixed 27deg; no target alignment. Structural annotation uncertainty approx 2-5px.
gate: Keep existing gate: clear important-error improvement without worse core feature or violated composition; no use-blocking defect for advertising. Same choice means no selection improvement. Tiny differences within annotation uncertainty are inconclusive.
stop_rule: One modification only. If not improved, stop tuning this selector and move to a different experiment; no further weights tried on these targets.
data_separation: No target RGB or target annotations before freeze. Prior Run19/20 results motivated the change and are development evidence, not unseen validation. New views same product are not cross-product validation.
resources: CPU, existing dependencies, cached official archive; no GPU or paid API.
